answer.reason: Only the LORD's sworn word that Bozrah will become a desolation (JER 49:13) says something of the place beyond the summary.

clauses.english: was doomed by the LORD's oath to become a desolation and a curse
clauses.quote: Bozrah shall become a desolation, a reproach, a waste, and a curse

doubts: MIC 2:12 only uses the sheep of Bozrah as a comparison, so it was left out.
GEN 36:33 and 1CH 1:44 name Jobab of Bozrah, a king list entry about a person, so they were left out.
ISA 34:6, ISA 63:1, JER 49:22 and AMO 1:12 are figurative or foretell judgment on Edom, so only the oath in JER 49:13 was used.
